name: Methods for Design Thinking
description: Introduction to design thinking (definition, importance, history and evolution, case-studies), design thinking methodologies (stanford d-school, double-diamond of UK design council, IDEO model, Google design sprint, RIDES), empathise (observation, interaction, identification of pain-/pleasure- points and design opportunities), define (design problem and needs), Ideate (generate, evaluate and select ideas/concepts), prototype (types, physical and virtual prototyping, low- and high- fidelity prototyping), test (utility and usability testing methods, iterate).
